spec.name: News tone v5
spec.notes: Long names with improving news sentiment.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.9, annual return 6%, maximum drawdown 5%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy uses a 'lag: 0' configuration, which implies that the sentiment signal is available and tradable at the exact same time as the market close. In real-world trading, news sentiment processing and order execution require non-zero latency. Without a realistic lag, the backtest likely incorporates lookahead bias, leading to inflated performance metrics. Furthermore, the research log indicates only two trials were conducted, which is insufficient to establish the robustness of the signal. I recommend moving to paper trading to verify that the strategy can achieve these returns under real-time execution constraints before committing any capital.
